source: Original hand-authored native pixel sprites based on the approved direction of the original generated front-identity concept; no cropped imagegen walk-sheet pixels.
style: Chunky chibi humans with large heads, broad colored costumes, crisp single pixel outlines and intentional color clusters; no blur/antialiasing/fine imagegen noise. 12 sign silhouettes and dominant colors, matching male/female identities. Male/female skin-tone/hair styling may vary; no robots or Greek/gold ornaments.
requirements: Glyph on dark chest or back panel; head silhouette carries sign identity in all directions
Distinct actual side faces; LEFT must not facefront/RIGHT; UP has no front face
Three actual stride/idle poses eachdirection, never repeated/mirrored idle substituted as walk
No sprite clipping or neighbor-frame bleed, preserve full32pxnativeformat
Normal1xand4x contact sheet on navy and beach backgrounds before any livecatalogchange
